items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: They had him, Hellman Umphrey on the, on the Clown-Eyed. He said, he had a bass.

ctx.x: Ask him did he know Joe Oliver?

Did you know Joe Oliver? Oh yeah, Joe. He was on the corner from Joe Oliver. That's the time I used to go to the Royal Guard. He got that job out today. Bless you know. Yeah, he was the king out there. And then when he was older than me, he was about five or six years old than me. But I know them when they first had a band organized. There was a brother named Kintin. He had all these youngsters from fifteen to eighteen years old playing a bass band. He used to carry them all around in different places up and down…
Who was in that band? Kinkins Band or Jenkins?
